players.product: prepreg / low-loss laminate for high-multilayer AI-server and switch PCBs (Isu Petasys supplier)

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 results (management, earnings call): revenue up 42% QoQ and 110% YoY as growth keeps accelerating; operating margin reached 23.5% in Q2, up from 18.2% in Q1 and roughly double a year ago, breaking above 20% for the first time as scale effects let opex grow slower than revenue. Non-operating items minor (interest and FX from the NT dollar); tax rate elevated on undistributed-earnings tax and Southeast Asia expansion.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 revenue +42% QoQ, +110% YoY; operating margin 23.5% (vs 18.2% in Q1)

quarterly_data.signal: Mix and pricing: a broad laminate price-increase wave hit in Q2 - the lower the grade, the larger the hike (specific increases not disclosed, they vary by customer). Despite low-end prices rising more, mix still shifted up: M7/M8 ultra-low-loss laminates rose from 38% to 39% of revenue while mid/low-loss M4/M6 grades slipped from 32% to 31%, so the product mix keeps optimising toward the high end and management sees plenty of margin headroom left. The special-products line (thick-copper and special-resin boards supporting power applications) nearly doubled its share over four quarters - 8% in Q3 2025, 10% in Q4 2025, 12% in Q1 2026, 14% in Q2 - with management calling TUC a leader in that niche.
quarterly_data.figure: M7/M8 share 38% to 39% of revenue; M4/M6 32% to 31%; thick-copper/power special products 14% of revenue in Q2 (from 12% in Q1, 10% in Q4 2025)

quarterly_data.signal: Thailand ramp and inventory: Thailand plant phase 2 mass production slipped about two months on equipment-delivery delays, but phase-1 experience shortened the ramp curve - it began contributing shipments in July 2026, ramps through August, should help Q3 results and reach full output by Q4 2026. Inventory stands at NT$100 hundred million with turnover days down to 90 despite much higher revenue; management says inventory must keep rising as new capacity opens.
quarterly_data.figure: Thailand phase 2 contributing from July 2026, full output by Q4; inventory NT$100 hundred million, 90 turnover days

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity expansion: after the March 11, 2026 board approved 120 ten-thousand-sheet capacity plus 60 ten-thousand sheets in Thailand, this board approved a further 2028-2029 plan adding 195 ten-thousand sheets of laminate capacity - 120 at Zhongshan and 75 at Thailand plant phase 2 - and resolved to issue NT$100 hundred million of convertible bonds to fund it.
quarterly_data.figure: new 2028-2029 capacity plan +195 ten-thousand sheets (Zhongshan 120, Thailand 75); NT$100 hundred million convertible bond issue
